_note: Structural editorial decisions (section boundaries; a printed label that opens a composition) -- never text, never author. Applied by pipeline/structure.py (build_corpus post-pass 5) only when status is 'approved'. Each entry states what it expects to find (`from`); the build fails if the corpus no longer matches. Evidence quotes the print verbatim, copied from the corpus by script.

entries.evidence: Ang 1364, line 58297, printed heading: ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ
entries.reason: The collection opens with its own printed heading and runs to the line before the next collection's heading (Ang 1377). The canonical name is the pipeline's own section list (sggs_pipeline.SECTIONS).

entries.evidence: Ang 695, line 30081, printed label: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਸੈਣੁ ॥ -- closing line 30091: ਸੈਨੁ ਭਣੈ ਭਜੁ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦੇ ॥੪॥੨॥

The label becomes the heading of its own composition; 5381 is issued above every id the build has issued (5380), so no comp_id moves.
